children: MARA sold 13,597 Bitcoin for about $1.1 billion, repaid its Bitcoin-backed loans and freed 17,477 pledged BTC. It may sell more Bitcoin and approved a $500 million share buyback.
MARA Holdings said it cut debt by $1.4 billion, or 37%, year to date. Its Exaion unit also signed a four-year, $79 million GPU-as-a-service deal.
MARA Holdings reported third-quarter revenue of $164.2 million, down about 35% year over year, and authorized up to $500 million in share buybacks; the full amount may not be spent.
Analysts cut MARA’s average 12-month price target to $16.23 from $16.54. The consensus rating stayed Buy, with 10 Buy, four Hold and two Sell calls among 16 analysts.
